full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows a solitary person from behind at the end of a narrow, weathered jetty. The figure stands near the horizontal center of the image, wearing a dark jacket and straight trousers, arms hanging at the sides. Short dark hair forms a small round silhouette against the pale sky. The jetty begins broad and irregular at the bottom edge, then narrows in perspective toward the person's feet. Its surface is wet, cracked, and rough, with small puddles or reflective patches catching the overcast light. Dark stones and shallow water flank the path in the foreground. Beyond the figure, a calm gray expanse of sea stretches to a low horizon; a faint, thin strip of distant buildings lies just left of center. The sky takes up the upper half of the panel, nearly featureless except for soft cloud gradations that brighten toward the horizon. There is no direct sun. Flat, diffused daylight produces silvery midtones on water and sky while the jetty and figure remain deep charcoal. A faint mist softens the separation between water, distant skyline, and air. The subject is quite small in the total frame, and the straight path acts as a clear visual arrow toward the still person. Wide negative space on either side emphasizes the scale of the water. The camera is aligned with the jetty at a low-to-moderate height, giving the scene a symmetrical, quiet gravity. Fine grain and imperfect surface detail preserve a documentary feel, while the careful central placement makes the isolation feel deliberate and contemplative.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片描绘一名孤身人物背对镜头，站在狭窄、风化堤道的尽头。人物位于画面水平中央附近，穿深色外套和直筒长裤，双臂垂在身侧。短黑发在浅色天空前形成小小圆形剪影。堤道从下边缘宽阔而不规则地起步，随后按透视收窄，通向人物脚边。表面潮湿、开裂且粗糙，小水洼或反光斑块接住阴天光线。深色石块与浅水夹住前景道路。人物身后，平静的灰色海面延伸至低地平线；一条模糊而细的远处建筑带位于中央略左。天空占据画面上半部，除了向地平线渐亮的柔和云灰变化，几乎没有具体特征。没有直射阳光。平坦漫射的日光在水天形成银灰中间调，堤道和人物则保持深炭色。轻微雾气柔化水面、远处天际线和空气的分界。人物在整幅图中很小，笔直道路如清楚的箭头指向静止的人。两侧宽阔留白强调水面的尺度。相机沿堤道轴线，以较低到中等高度拍摄，让场景具有对称而安静的重量。细颗粒与不完美的表面细节保留纪实感，谨慎的居中安排则使孤立感显得有意而沉思。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography uses a central vanishing path, low horizon, and broad empty tonal fields to build a quiet sense of distance. Deep charcoal foreground texture gradually yields to silvery water, mist, and pale overcast sky. Flat diffuse daylight removes sharp shadows while preserving small wet highlights and rough surface marks. Keep the distant edge soft, the main vertical accent small, and the framing nearly symmetrical. Fine grain and slight atmospheric blur support a documentary, contemplative mood; strong geometry supplies structure without theatrical lighting.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影通过中央消失路径、低地平线和宽阔空白色调区域建立安静的距离感。深炭色前景质地逐渐让位于银灰水面、雾气和浅色阴天空。平坦漫射日光去掉尖锐阴影，同时保留小小湿润高光和粗糙表面痕迹。远方边界保持柔和，主要竖形重音保持微小，取景近乎对称。细颗粒与轻微空气模糊支撑纪实、沉思的情绪；有力几何结构无需戏剧灯光便可成立。
theme_en: A solitary figure at the end of a narrow jetty facing an empty gray sea
theme_zh: 孤身人物立于狭窄堤道尽头，面对空阔灰海
name: Sohrab Hura
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
